DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 途中のご退出についてのお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about leaving partway through?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車に耳栓を忘れました。取りに出て、また公演へ戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 耳栓を車へ取りに出て戻れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot my earplugs in the car. Can I go and get them, then return to the performance?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can get earplugs from the car and return.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 本日の再入場の案内を確認します。戻る際に使う券はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check today's re-entry instructions. Do you have the ticket to use on return?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同行者が席に残るので、その人の券を借りて戻ろうと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者の券を借りて戻るつもりだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: My companion is staying at the seat, so I thought I'd borrow their ticket to return.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you planned to borrow your companion's ticket for returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同行者の券ではなく、ご本人の入場記録を確認します。ご自身の券を表示できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check your own admission record, not your companion's ticket. Can you display your own ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。私のスマホにあります。この券で退出の確認を受ける場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の券で退出確認を受ける方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, on my phone. Please tell me where to have my exit checked using this ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to get exit confirmation with your own ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの担当が券と退出を確認します。同行者の方へのご連絡は済んでいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: This staff member will check the ticket and exit. Have you contacted your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私だけ耳栓を取りに行くと伝えました。戻るまでは席を離れず待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券が本人端末にあると示し同行者との合流を調整する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I told them only I'm going to get earplugs. I'll ask them to stay in the seat until I'm back.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your ticket is on your own device and coordinate meeting with your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、本日の再入場に必要な表示を説明します。退出前にお聞きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff will explain the display needed for today's re-entry. Please hear it before leaving.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて自分の券で確認を受けてから出ます。同行者の券は借りず、耳栓を持ってこの入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 退出確認と再入場案内を受けて一人で取りに行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hear the explanation and get my own ticket checked before going out. I won't borrow my companion's ticket, and will return to this entrance with earplugs.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will receive exit and re-entry guidance and go alone to retrieve the earplugs.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では退出の担当へお進みください。戻る入口と必要な表示は、この案内でご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then proceed to the exit staff. You can confirm the return entrance and required display in this guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 祈願のお申込みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for a prayer?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。遠くに住む母のためにお願いしたいです。申込書には来た私の名前を書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族のための祈願申込みを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like it for my mother who lives far away. Should I write my own name as the person here on the application?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about applying for a prayer for family.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お願いする方のお名前と、連絡する方を別に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll ask separately for the person receiving the prayer and the contact person.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 願うのは母で、今日来ているのは私だけです。母が参列するという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 願う本人と来訪者が異なることを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's for my mother, and only I am here today. I don't mean she is attending.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the person prayed for differs from the visitor.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お母様のお名前を、読み方も添えてお示しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show your mother's name along with its reading.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この名前です。読みは下に書きました。外国の名前なので、こちらを見て確認していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人氏名を示し読み方を添える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This name. I've written the reading below. It's a foreign name, so I'd like you to check from here.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the person's name and add its reading in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認しました。当日の連絡が必要な場合は、どなたへご連絡しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Confirmed. If contact is needed today, whom should we contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 母ではなく私へお願いします。母は今、日本語の電話に答えられないので、私の番号を連絡欄へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日の連絡は来訪者へ希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Me, not my mother, please. She can't answer a Japanese phone call now, so I'll put my number in the contact field.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that same-day contact should go to the visitor.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、祈願する方のお名前と連絡先を読み返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I'll read back the prayer recipient's name and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母の名義で合っています。連絡先は私ですね。今日の受付方法を教えていただき、この内容で申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二つの名前の役割を読み返して受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: My mother's name is correct. The contact is me. Please explain today's registration method; I'd like to apply with these details.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read back the two names' roles in Japanese and request registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その区別で承りました。申込みの案内をお渡ししますので、次の受付へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've accepted that distinction. We'll give you application guidance; please proceed to the next reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your appointment slips?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二つの科の予約があります。一枚ずつ受付するのか、先にどちらへ行くのか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同日二科の受付順を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have appointments in two departments. Please tell me whether to check in with each slip and which to visit first.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about same-day check-in order for two departments.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの科と予約時刻を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show each department and appointment time?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内科が九時、皮膚科が十時です。皮膚科の紙を上に入れていたので、そちらへ先に行こうとしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚の予約票の時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Internal medicine at nine and dermatology at ten. The dermatology paper was on top, so I nearly went there first.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the times on the two appointment slips in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 九時の予約から確認します。十時の予約もあることを受付へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check from the nine o'clock appointment. I'll tell reception about the ten o'clock appointment too.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では内科を先に受けます。二つ目の予約があることも、内科の受付へ伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に受ける科を確定しもう一科への連絡を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll have internal medicine first. Please also tell its reception that I have a second appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the first department in Japanese and request communication about the other.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。診療の長さは、この時点では分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We don't know how long the consultation will take yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 十時を過ぎそうなら、皮膚科へ自分で行くより内科の受付に相談すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 終了が遅れた場合の連絡方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: If it looks likely to go past ten, should I ask internal-medicine reception rather than go to dermatology myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to communicate if completion is delayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今いる受付へ、次の予約票を示してご相談ください。担当同士で状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Show the next appointment slip at your current reception and ask. The staff will check together.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時間順に紙を分けました。先に内科へ行き、遅れそうな時は十時の票を見せて受付へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 票を時間順に分け遅れは受付へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've separated the papers by time. I'll go to internal medicine first, and if it may be late, show the ten o'clock slip to reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you sorted slips by time and will notify reception about delay.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二科の予約として申し送りました。こちらの案内に沿って内科の受付へお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've passed it on as two department appointments. Follow this guidance to internal-medicine reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得の連絡を受けてお越しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you come after a found-property call?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 免許証を預かっていると電話がありました。財布を失くしたので、財布ごと見つかったのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 免許証の連絡で財布も見つかったか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was called to say you have my driver's licence. I lost my wallet; was the whole wallet found?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the wallet was found too after a licence call.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 連絡の番号を確認します。今回お預かりしているのは免許証一枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the contact number. What we have this time is one driver's licence.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 財布にはほかのカードも入っていました。免許証だけ見つかったなら、財布全部が戻ったわけではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紛失物の全体と通知された物を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There were other cards in the wallet. If only the licence was found, that doesn't mean the whole wallet is back.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese all lost belongings from the notified found item.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。受取についての確認をご案内します。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 財布の中の本人確認書類も失くしています。免許証を受け取るために、今ある資料でどう確認するか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 免許証の受取に必要な確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also lost the ID documents in the wallet. Please tell me how my current materials can verify me to collect the licence.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about identification needed to receive the licence.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの資料を担当へお見せください。財布の届出番号も分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show the adviser what you have. Do you also know the wallet report number?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この控えです。免許証の情報は直したいですが、財布とほかのカードの相談は続けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布と他カードの相談を継続したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This receipt. I'd like to update the licence information, but continue the inquiry for the wallet and other cards.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want the wallet and other-card inquiry to continue.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その範囲で担当へ伝えます。別の物が見つかった際も、確認してから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell staff that scope. If something else is found, we'll also confirm before contacting you.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は免許証の受取方法を確認します。受け取った後、届出では免許証だけを発見済みに直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 免許証受取と未発見品の情報訂正を別に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I'll check how to collect the licence. After I receive it, please mark only the licence as found in the report.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese separately for licence collection and correction of the remaining missing-property record.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 免許証の受取と、ほかの未発見品を残すご希望で承りました。担当の窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've noted licence collection and keeping the other missing items active. I'll direct you to the responsible counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの机をご検討ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 折り畳めば小さくなるので、家の玄関から運べそうです。配送で頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折畳机が玄関から運べるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since it folds smaller, I think it can fit through my entrance. Can I request delivery?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the folding desk can be carried through your entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示の寸法だけでなく、箱に入った大きさも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the boxed size, not only display dimensions.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 机の幅は七十センチですね。家の入口は八十センチなので、それだけを見て大丈夫と思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示寸法と自宅入口幅を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The desk is seventy centimetres wide. My entrance is eighty, so I assumed it would fit based on that alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give display dimensions and home entrance width in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 梱包すると寸法が変わります。外箱の表示はこちらの資料です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Packaging changes the dimensions. Here is the outer-box information.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 箱の横幅も控えます。配送の時に、玄関で箱を開けてもらえるかも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱の外寸を資料で求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll note the box width too. I'd also like to check whether delivery staff can open the box at the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the outer box dimensions in the materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 配送の対応は担当へ照会します。入口の先は、まっすぐですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask delivery staff about that service. Is it straight beyond the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: すぐ廊下が曲がります。入口だけでなく、曲がる所の幅も測る必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 箱を開ける場所と廊下の曲がり角を追加確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The hallway turns immediately. I need to measure the bend's width as well as the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Additionally check unpacking location and the hallway corner in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通路の写真と寸法があると相談できます。今日は配送を確定しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can consult with route photos and dimensions. Are you finalizing delivery today?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は保留します。箱の寸法を持ち帰り、廊下を測ってから、開梱の対応も含めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅を測り直すため購入を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll hold off today. I'll take the box dimensions, measure the hallway, and consult about unpacking arrangements too.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will defer purchasing to measure home again.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 資料をお持ちください。採寸後、この商品の番号で担当へご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take the information. After measuring, you can ask staff using this product number.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の状態についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss the product's condition.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った冷凍野菜が大きな固まりになっていました。買った時からか分からないので、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍品の固まりが大きいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The frozen vegetables I bought yesterday were in a large lump. I don't know whether they were that way when bought, so I'd like it checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about large clumps in a frozen product.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの時間と、家での保管を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tell me the travel time home and storage at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店から家までは二十分です。家で袋から出した時に気付き、残りは冷凍庫へ戻しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入後の持帰り時間と家での取扱いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Twenty minutes from store to home. I noticed when taking them out of the bag at home and put the remainder back in the freezer.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese transport time after purchase and handling at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 購入時、袋の中の状態はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you see the condition inside the bag when buying?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋が不透明で見ていません。開けた後の写真と、買った時のレシートはあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入時未観察と開封後の写真を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The bag was opaque, so no. I have a photo after opening and the purchase receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese no observation at purchase from an after-opening photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。現物は今も冷凍庫にあるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with staff. The actual product is still in your freezer, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。相談のために持ってくると溶けそうです。持参が必要か、先に写真で確認できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現物持参可否と保存中の対応を担当へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Bringing it for consultation may make it thaw. I'd like to ask whether to bring it or whether photographs can be checked first.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about bringing the actual product and handling it while stored.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から資料と現物の扱いをご案内します。状態をここだけで判断することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The adviser will guide you on documentation and the product. We can't judge its condition just here.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真、レシート、家へ着いた時刻を用意します。結果を聞くまでは食べず、現物の持参方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入記録と時系列で照会し結果まで食べないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll prepare the photo, receipt and home-arrival time. I won't eat it before hearing the result, and will check how to bring the actual item.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will inquire with records and chronology and not eat it pending the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を担当へ伝えました。連絡の案内をお渡ししますので、資料を残してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've told the adviser. I'll give you contact guidance; please retain the materials and wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 確認票の内容で気になる所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Any concerns about the confirmation sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 建物名が書いていません。さっき申請書には書いたので、消えてしまったのか気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 確認票に建物名がないと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: The building name isn't there. I wrote it on the application earlier, so I'm concerned it disappeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the confirmation sheet lacks the building name.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 番地と部屋番号は、お間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the street number and apartment number correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこは合っています。引っ越し先を変えたいのではなく、同じ住所の建物名の確認です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号は一致し転居変更ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: They are. I don't want to change where I'm moving; it's checking the building name for the same address.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that numbers match and this is not a change of residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物名の分かる書類を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show a document with the building name.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この契約書です。部屋番号の前の名前を、申請書にも同じように書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出した契約書で建物名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: This lease. I wrote the name before the apartment number the same way on the application.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the building name on the submitted lease in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認票の表示と登録内容を、担当が照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The adviser will compare the confirmation display with registered contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。紙の表示だけが短くなっているのか、登録にも入っていないのかを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示省略と登録漏れのどちらか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please. I'd like to know whether the paper display is just shortened or the registration omits it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether it is a display abbreviation or missing registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照合した結果をご説明します。それまでは新しい住所の変更申請を出す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain the comparison result. Until then, there is no need for a new address-change application.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住所はこのままで、建物名の登録結果を待ちます。漏れていた場合だけ、直す方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在住所のまま登録結果を確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the address as it is and wait for the building-name registration result. Only if omitted, please explain correction.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check registration with the current address unchanged.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 同じ住所の建物名の確認として受け付けました。契約書を返却しますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Accepted as a building-name check at the same address. I'll return your lease; please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申告の資料についてのお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about tax filing materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社から同じ年の書類が二枚来ました。金額が違うので、どちらを持って相談に行けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社の差替え資料でどちらを相談に使うか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company sent two documents for the same year. The amounts differ; which should I take to the consultation?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese which company replacement document to use for advice.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対象の年と、会社からの説明を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's confirm the target year and company's explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらも今年分です。違う年の収入ではなく、会社が後から送り直した物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両資料の対象期間が同じと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both are for this year. It's not income from different years; the company resent one later.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the documents cover the same period.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送り直した理由が分かる案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is there guidance explaining why it was resent?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールに訂正版とあります。新しい金額を自分で正しいと決める前に、このメールも見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社から訂正と案内されたメッセージを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: The email says “corrected version.” Before deciding the new amount is right myself, I'd like you to see this email too.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the company's correction message in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正の説明と両方の書類で、担当へ相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Consult the adviser with the correction explanation and both documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い物も、届いた経緯が分かるよう残して持って行きます。合計して二件の収入にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧資料も経緯用に残して持参する希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep and bring the old one too so the sequence is clear. I won't add them as two income entries.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will retain and bring the old materials to explain the sequence.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同じ対象期間の差替えとして、資料を区別してお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep them distinct as a replacement for the same period.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい方に訂正版、古い方に差替え前とメモします。届いた日と会社のメールも添えて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新旧表示と差替え日を付けて相談資料を準備する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll label the new one corrected and the old one before replacement. I'll include received dates and the company email for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare in Japanese consultation materials with new/old labels and replacement dates.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その資料で差替えの内容を担当へ確認できます。申告への反映方法は、相談時にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Those materials let staff check the replacement. Confirm how to reflect it in the return during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文は大盛の辛いラーメンですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your order is a large spicy ramen, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 辛さは控えめにできますか。さっき普通と答えたのは辛さのことではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 辛さ控えめを注文内容に追加したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: Can the spice be mild? When I said regular earlier, I didn't mean spiciness.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to add mild spice to the order.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 普通というのは、麺の量のことでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。麺は普通の量です。辛さを相談している間に、大盛になっていたようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 麺量を大盛と誤認されていると訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, regular noodles. It seems it became large while we discussed spice.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct in Japanese the mistaken large-noodle quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 麺は普通に直します。ほかに変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll change noodles to regular. Any other changes?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 具のねぎだけ追加したいです。麺を増やすのではなく、具の追加でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 普通量で具の追加だけを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like only extra green onion topping. Not more noodles; extra topping, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese regular quantity with only added topping.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ねぎの追加分はこちらの料金です。辛さは控えめでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the extra onion charge. Mild spice is correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。普通の麺、辛さ控えめ、ねぎ追加の一杯ですね。この料金で全部含まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 辛さと量と追加料金を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. One regular noodle portion, mild spice, extra onion. Does this price include everything?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare spice, quantity and extra charge in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今お伝えした内容の金額です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. It is the amount for the details just discussed.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それで注文をお願いします。辛さの普通と麺量の普通を混ぜて伝えてしまって、失礼しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確定した一杯の内容で注文を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please place that order. I'm sorry I mixed up regular spice with regular noodle quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to order the confirmed bowl.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 麺は普通、辛さ控えめ、ねぎ追加で承りました。お席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Regular noodles, mild spice and extra onion accepted. Please wait at your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お飲み物はお決まりでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 柑橘にアレルギーがあります。この飲み物の飾りのレモンを、載せずに作れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 柑橘アレルギーで飾り付き飲物を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a citrus allergy. Can you make this drink without its lemon garnish?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a garnished drink with your citrus allergy.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 飲み物自体にも柑橘が含まれるか、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask staff whether the drink itself also contains citrus.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 飾りだけだと思っていました。出てきてから外すつもりでしたが、それでは確認になりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 飾りを後で外すつもりだったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought it was only garnish. I planned to remove it after serving, but that wouldn't verify the ingredients.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you planned to remove the garnish afterwards.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 使う材料も調べます。どの範囲を確認したいかお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the ingredients too. Tell us what extent you want confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 中の果汁と、準備の時にレモンに触れるかも含めてお願いします。できると分かるまでは注文しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲物自体の原料と準備時の接触も確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: The juice inside and whether lemon is touched during preparation too, please. I won't order until we know it can be made that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check the drink ingredients and contact during preparation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この飲み物は、その条件を今すべて確認できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can't confirm all those conditions for this drink now.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら今回はやめます。未開封の飲み物で、私が表示を見て選べる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認が難しい候補を見送り別の未開封品を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll skip it this time. Are there unopened drinks whose labels I can read and choose myself?
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline the unconfirmed option in Japanese and ask about another unopened product.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの瓶入り飲料の表示をご覧いただけます。開けずにお持ちしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can read this bottled drink's label. I brought it unopened.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を確認しました。この飲み物を、レモンを添えずにお願いします。開封は内容を確認してからで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示確認後に開封する飲物を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the label. This drink with no lemon, please. Opening it after confirming the contents is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese a drink to be opened after label confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの瓶の飲み物を、果物を添えずに承りました。この後開封してお出しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-011-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: This bottled drink without fruit, accepted. We'll open and serve it now.
